note: Tier 1t should-be-empty prompts: off-history messages that name a time the date resolver reads (P07), so a time-range boost can be checked for false inclusions. Hand-written, dev split only; there is no held-out part.

prompts.prompt: Why are stock markets closed on weekends? I tried to check a price last Saturday.
prompts.why: Asks how markets work; the Saturday is an aside.

prompts.prompt: Who won the Champions League final two weeks ago?
prompts.why: Public sports news, not anything said in chat.

prompts.prompt: How do I convert a PDF to a Word document? I couldn't figure it out yesterday.
prompts.why: A how-to question; yesterday's attempt adds nothing to look up.

prompts.prompt: Which planets were visible in the night sky in March?
Summarize the biggest science news from the past three months.
prompts.why: World news, not the user's history.

prompts.prompt: When does daylight saving time end? I think the clocks changed last Sunday.
prompts.why: A calendar fact about the world.

prompts.prompt: What's the capital of Australia? My kid asked me last week and I blanked.
prompts.why: Trivia; the anecdote holds no reference to history.

prompts.prompt: How do you say good morning in Japanese? I learned it in March but forgot.
Why does water boil at a lower temperature up a mountain? We noticed it last weekend.
What's the fastest way to defrost a windshield? It took forever three days ago.
What were the top-grossing movies in the past two months?
prompts.why: Box office news, not the user's history.

prompts.prompt: Explain how a solar eclipse works, there was one a few days ago.
